prompt: A printer prints $24$ pages in $3$ minutes. How many pages can it print in $10$ minutes at the same rate?
hint: Ten is not a multiple of three, so scaling directly is awkward. Find how many pages the printer makes in a single minute.

hints.text: Ten is not a multiple of three, so scaling directly is awkward. Find how many pages the printer makes in a single minute.
The printer makes $24 \div 3 = 8$ pages each minute. Multiply that rate by $10$ minutes.
$8 \times 10 = 80$, so the printer prints $80$ pages in $10$ minutes.

explanation: Find the unit rate by dividing pages by minutes: $24 \div 3 = 8$ pages per minute.
At the same rate, every minute adds $8$ more pages, so multiply by the $10$ minutes.
Multiplying the rate by the time gives $8 \times 10 = 80$ pages.
The printer can print $80$ pages in $10$ minutes.
